name: Guarded
source:
You're filming a Hollywood movie when an accident threatens your safety. Can your new bodyguard protect you and your heart?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Guarded]Choices Wikia[/url]]

你正在拍攝一部好萊塢電影，一場意外卻危及你的安全。新來的保鏢能保護你的人，也護住你的心嗎？
